description: This file defines the LobbyController class responsible for managing lobby/matchmaking real-time connection state in a Flutter application. It handles websocket connection initialization, listens to various online events, manages match-making requests (quick match, cancel), and resource cleanup.

classes.name: LobbyController
classes.description: A controller class extending ChangeNotifier to manage lobby state and websocket connection events in a Flutter app.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes websocket connection and subscribes to online events.

methods.name: quickMatch
methods.description: Sends a quick match request to the server.

methods.name: cancelQuickMatch
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing quick match request.

methods.name: disposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously cleans up websocket resources and subscriptions.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Overrides the default dispose to call disposeAsync without awaiting.
